scenarios.name: Decision Registration and Cross-Session Retrieval
scenarios.verification: Session 1 registers ADR-001 with evidenceReference; Session 2 queries and retrieves it in Top-1 with full provenance intact.

scenarios.name: Atomic Decision Supersession and Obsolete Deprecation
scenarios.verification: StorageEngine.supersedeKnowledgeDecision atomically transitions old item to SUPERSEDED, creates new ACCEPTED item, establishes canonical SUPERSEDES relation; normal queries return new item, includeObsolete:false filters old item, historical query retrieves old item.

scenarios.name: Epistemic Status Differentiation
scenarios.verification: Correctly classifies items into VERIFIED_FACT (with evidence), WORKING_HYPOTHESIS, and UNVALIDATED_OBSERVATION.

scenarios.name: Complete Provenance & Audit Trail Recovery via MCP
scenarios.verification: MCP openmemory_query_knowledge outputs rich Markdown rendering with 🟢 [VERIFIED FACT] badge, originating agentId, timestamp, and bold Evidence Reference.

scenarios.name: Multi-Project Sandboxing & Fail-Closed Boundary
scenarios.verification: MCP server bound to workspace strictly rejects cross-project queries with fail-closed error code.

scenarios.name: Durability & Restart Integrity Across Cold Reboots
scenarios.verification: Instantiating a fresh StorageEngine on the same directory re-indexes all 5 items, preserves SUPERSEDED/ACCEPTED states, and reconstructs TMS graph views perfectly.

scenarios.name: Terminal State Protection and Non-Destructive Invalidation
scenarios.verification: Terminal state protection prevents resurrecting or double-superseding terminal items while preserving non-destructive audit trail on disk.
